description: Get an executable PowerSun offer when resource, amount, fixed-grid duration and target_address are supplied. Without all four fields, returns raw provider observations labelled as non-executable analytics.

amount.description: Exact resource amount for an executable quote.

duration.description: Filter to providers offering this exact duration in seconds (e.g. 3600 for 1h, 86400 for 1d, 604800 for 7d, 2592000 for 30d). Omit to see all tiers.

resource.description: Filter by resource type. Omit for all.

target_address.description: TRON recipient address for an executable quote.

name: get_prices
